description: The image displays four pie charts, each representing the distribution of refusal categories for a specific large language model—GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct—on the FactBench benchmark. Each chart is divided into two or three slices, with labels indicating the category name, the count of occurrences, and the corresponding percentage. The GPT4-o chart has two slices: “Safety” (1, 16.7%) in orange and “Lack of Knowledge” (5, 83.3%) in red. The Gemini1.5-Pro chart has four slices: “Safety” (8, 9.3%) in red, “Misinformation” (33, 38.4%) in orange, “Clarification” (12, 14.0%) in yellow, and “Lack of Knowledge” (19, 22.1%) in blue. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has two slices: “Lack of Knowledge” (3, 75.0%) in orange and “Clarification” (1, 25.0%) in red. The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart has two equal-sized slices: “Lack of Knowledge” (2, 50.0%) in orange and “Misinformation” (2, 50.0%) in red. All charts include percentage labels within their respective slices and are visually ordered with the largest segment typically at the bottom-right, though this is not strictly enforced across all models. There is no legend provided, and no slices are visually emphasized (e.g., exploded or bolded).
